author: New China TV
description:
In this short #documentary, Xinhua's Miao Xiaojuan @miaoxiaojuan sits down with Iowan students and educators who crossed the Pacific to experience China for themselves.

They returned with new #friendships, broader horizons, and a deeper understanding that people on both sides are often more alike than different.

With the original initiative to welcome 50,000 young #Americans to China completed ahead of schedule and a new invitation extended to 100,000 more over the next five years, a new generation is beginning to write the next chapter of #China-#US relations.

A Miao Xiaojuan Studio Film
A Xinhua News Agency Production
title: Iowa, Across the Pacific | "The hope of the China-U.S. relationship lies in the people"

author: New China TV
description:
Iowa, Across the Pacific | "Are we adversaries, or partners?"

What does the future hold for #China-#US relations? In this short #documentary, Xinhua's Miao Xiaojuan sits down with Kenneth Quinn, President Emeritus of the World Food Prize Foundation, to revisit his encounters with Chinese President #XiJinping, as well as #Iowa's distinctive role in bringing the two countries closer.

Inspired by President #Xi's 2023 speech in San Francisco, Quinn remains, at 84, a tireless advocate for #partnership over confrontation, and for what he calls "#peace through #agriculture."

A Miao Xiaojuan Studio Film
A Xinhua News Agency Production
title: Iowa, Across the Pacific | "Are we adversaries, or partners?"

author: New China TV
description:
Iowa, Across the Pacific | "To me, they are America"

Gary Dvorchak's childhood bedroom looked much like any other teenager's room in #Iowa, with #StarWars and #StarTrek posters on the walls and model spacecraft on display. In 1985, it became the room where a young Chinese county official named #XiJinping stayed during his first visit to the #UnitedStates.

In this short #documentary, Xinhua's Miao Xiaojuan sits down with Gary to revisit the Dvorchaks' lasting bond with China's first family, and explore what their story reveals about the power of people-to-people ties between the world's two largest economies.

A Miao Xiaojuan Studio Film
A Xinhua News Agency Production
title: Iowa, Across the Pacific | "To me, they are America"
